name: Room Light
definition: Estimates the colour of bounced light in a room by asking what colour light lands on surfaces around the player, then skewing the ambient lighting by that answer. Uses a single probe per room to avoid the cost of spatial variation (probes, per-pixel visibility, interpolation).
summary: Room Light estimates bounced light color using a single probe per room, avoiding the blotchy artifacts and high cost of spatial variation machinery found in full bounce solvers.
